entries.title: Open-Rear Sloped Teacher Lectern
entries.description: One original fixed classroom teacher lectern, counted as one complete prop. A continuous thick three-sided cabinet shell and full chamber floor rise to a genuinely inclined writing desk. The whole sloped desktop has an integral full-width raised retaining lip at the teacher-facing rear edge. One separate thick inner shelf forms two genuinely open rear storage bays, with narrow full-length side clearances; a broad closed plinth provides the whole ground sole. Four complete editable closed meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, public presentation front -Y, teacher access +Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. All numeric model geometry is newly authored. No old desk, counter, music stand, bookcase or instrument console geometry is imported, resized, recoloured or combined. No books, paper, electronics, chair, room, text, logo, texture or animation. Fixed visual furniture only: no writing comfort, retaining performance, item compatibility, storage capacity, human or age suitability, ergonomics, accessibility, educational effectiveness, adjustment, assembly path, load, strength, anti-tip stability, manufacture, installation or safety certification. Dimensions describe game-space geometry only.
